summary: A Yes vote authorizes the City of Richmond to issue $120 million in bonds to build firefighter housing and improve fire and emergency-response facilities, repaid through property taxes.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes $120 million in City of Richmond bonds, raising property taxes about $22.15 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund 911 emergency medical response and rehabilitate firefighter housing and facilities.
tax.quote: To support rapid, 911 emergency medical response, modernize and rehabilitate unsafe/deteriorating firefighter housing and facilities
